_comment: Example only. Copy to template_map.json next to your real template and replace the layout references with values from that template's profile (profile_template.py prints them). Layout refs may be a part stem (slideLayout3) or the layout's name.

understanding.notes: Their drivers left, our read right

team.notes: Delete unused member groups entirely — image and text boxes both

rules._vary_layouts_note: Never run more than two consecutive slides on the same layout — mapped sections spanning 3+ slides should alternate.
rules._respect_theme_fonts_note: Inherit fonts and colours from the template theme. Do not set explicit fonts or hex colours; that is how a deck silently drifts off-template.
